desc:
GHOSTFACE PRISON RUN! (Obby)

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support the game.

Complete 25 obstacle stages and escape the prison.
Jump across platforms and complete simple parkour challenges as you make your way to freedom.

Play solo or with friends.
Improve your best time and view your results on the leaderboard.

This game features obstacle-based gameplay and is intended for all ages.

Tags: Obby, Parkour, Platformer, Stages, Fun, Family Friendly
